conclusions: The diagnostic full run failed20pass/2timeout, with no skips or flaky results. Native return passed only on this temporary instrumentation cut. Original App01 remains FAIL21/1 at its unchanged product/test cut.

The native diagnostic shows root split readiness waiting, canonical B rev2 consumption, both local source/editor barriers, then one A view.open receipt at rev3 within724.7ms. It contains no IDB abort/error or native focus call. It does not reveal the precise uncompleted stage of the original uninstrumented native failure.

Activity/full-read assertions passed before navigation, including29 mounted rows and both final-line searches. Only Other placement was sent and committed rev2 before reload; no A placement POST was sent. Reload started16.736ms after the back-to-A click completed and correctly restored Other-active rev2. The final summary exists in hidden A, so its click waits until timeout. The existing test does not synchronize on completed canonical navigation before reload. No output-loss or conflict response was demonstrated.

Stale recovery consumed22.524s before reload in a30s test. Post-reload inputs200 preserved accepted-input and canKeepCaptured=true. Runner teardown began158995.043; Inspect completed160306.801; the final Keep click began160311.473,1316.430ms after teardown. The library trace stops158887.487 before that action and cannot diagnose later lazy-module completion or retry behavior. The captured DOM shows the expected owner and pending acknowledgment plus Loading source views.

No single common product or IDB cause is established. The activity failure is an observed incomplete-navigation prerequisite; the stale-recovery failure exhausts the whole-test budget before its last action. IDB diagnostics were enabled only for native return and cannot be generalized to the two other failures.

No product repair, assertion/deadline change, barrier bypass or second diagnostic attempt was made. All four original source files were restored byte-for-byte. Later Windows execution must remain separate platform evidence, not a claimed repair of these Linux results.
boundedTestProposal: If revising the activity case after review, assert Other tab selection after the first click, then original tab selection after the second click, using the existing assertion deadline before reloading. Keep all full-read/search/row/reload assertions. This proposal was not applied.
